translations./teaching/prediction_prompt: Same corridor, same forklift: which survives—12 m at 5 Hz or 5 m at 20 Hz?
translations./teaching/knowledge_card: Seeing far cannot replace seeing often. At 5 Hz the forklift moves 0.11 m between scans, so confirmation and extrapolation rely on old positions. The default build collides at the corridor’s east entrance; the recommended build earns every badge in 91.72 s.
